title: Small Compiler Subset Independent Compiler Driver
purpose: Put a bounded compiler-driver boundary in front of the accepted v0.1.78 integrated independent pipeline so BASIC# source files can produce real BSBC artifacts without routing the primary path through production compiler components.

allowed: adding compiler/small_compiler_subset_driver.rb as the bounded source-file to BSBC driver
routing the driver through SmallCompilerSubsetPipeline and its already-independent encoder, loader, and BSharp VM
writing real .bsbc artifacts and readable disassembly with the independent encoder atomic-write path
requiring exact artifact, event-result, final-world, and BSharp Save parity against separate production and Ruby referees
preserving Profiles 1 through 7 and all accepted creator-facing syntax
forbidden_until_later_approval: routing the primary driver through production Parser, SemanticResolver, BytecodeEmitter, BytecodeLoader, BytecodeVirtualMachine, Runtime, or runtime transition
changing normal BASIC# production compiler routing

acceptance_rules: SmallCompilerSubsetDriver must instantiate SmallCompilerSubsetPipeline on its primary path.
SmallCompilerSubsetDriver must not require, instantiate, or call production compiler, bytecode loader, bytecode VM, Runtime, or runtime-transition components on its primary path.
The driver must compile a real .bsbc artifact whose bytes exactly match the independent pipeline bytes.
The driver primary path must still compile, reload, and execute when production compiler and runtime constructors are disabled.
The dedicated fixture artifact must match separate production-emitter bytes exactly.
No Profile 8, new creator syntax, binary-format change, full self-hosting claim, or Ruby retirement is allowed.
